observations: Photo 0: a used automatic transmission/gearbox assembly lying on the ground, chalk-marked 'A8L' on the casing, surrounded by workshop debris and people's legs/feet.
Photo 1: close-up of the torque-converter bell housing, again chalk-marked 'A8L' near the center bore, with a wheel/tire leaning against the frame in the background.
Photo 2: another angle of the same transmission unit resting on a metal cart/frame, wiring and hydraulic lines hanging loose, no clear manufacturer tag visible.
No factory part-number plate, VIN sticker, or Audi logo is legible in any photo.
No other 'Audi A8L parts' (engine, suspension, body panels, etc.) are shown despite the seller's blanket claim.

claims.evidence: Only one transmission unit is shown across all 3 photos; no other parts are visible to confirm a wider inventory.

claims.claim: Implied: this transmission is a genuine Audi A8L unit
claims.evidence: Chalk handwriting 'A8L' is seller-applied, not a factory part tag or VIN plate visible in any photo.

risks.risk: Fitment/model claim cannot be confirmed as a genuine Audi A8L transmission rather than a relabeled or similar unit.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the OEM part-number sticker/casting number on the transmission case.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unverified-fitment used transmission, not a confirmed Audi A8L unit

risks.risk: Working condition of the transmission (shifting, internal wear, fluid condition) cannot be seen in static photos.
risks.proof: Video of the unit being bench-tested or installed and shifting through gears.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: Mileage, accident history, or flood damage of the donor vehicle is unknown.
risks.proof: Photos of the donor vehicle's odometer, VIN plate, or a salvage/parts invoice.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, worst case

risks.risk: Seller's claim of having 'all parts' for an Audi A8L is unverifiable and may be a general advertising line rather than an actual inventory.
risks.proof: Photos/videos of the other specific parts being requested, each clearly shown.
risks.if_unproven: only the photographed transmission is priced; other parts are not assumed to exist

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any part-number or VIN sticker/plate on the transmission casing.
Video of the transmission being tested (shifting, no leaks, torque converter spin).
Photo of the donor vehicle (dashboard/VIN) this unit was removed from.
If other 'A8L parts' are for sale, individual clear photos of each specific part.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used automatic transmission assembly, chalk-marked as Audi A8L but with no verifiable factory tag or working-condition proof, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified-fitment, unknown-condition used transmission.
